LPG e-KYC Deadline Extended Amid Technical Glitches

The deadline for domestic LPG consumers to complete Aadhaar biometric authentication for e-KYC has been extended to August 23. This extension comes after widespread reports of server crashes and app failures hindering millions of consumers from completing the process. Failure to complete the e-KYC was previously warned to result in the suspension of subsidies and potentially higher prices for cylinders, with some outlets reporting the original deadline as August 16.
